objects: one current source permanent and logical incarnation
events: resolve one fixed positive Adapt instruction
place +1/+1 counters through the canonical counter transaction
state_writes: replacement-aware +1/+1 counter placement only when the source currently has no +1/+1 counters
timing: Adapt's counter condition is checked on resolution rather than as an activation restriction
choices: counter-replacement ordering remains scoped to the affected permanent's controller
apnap: ordinary multiplayer priority and replacement ordering apply
layers: the condition reads counters on the current permanent; effective characteristic changes do not copy or remove those counters
replacement_effects: counter quantity replacements suspend before the atomic counter commit
copy: copied or granted Adapt requires independently trusted typed ability propagation
control_change: the resolving stack object's controller remains the action actor while the current permanent supplies the affected-object controller
zone_change: a source that leaves and returns is a new object and cannot receive counters from the old stack object
source_leaves: a missing, phased-out, or new source incarnation makes the resolving Adapt instruction do nothing

known_blockers: zero or variable Adapt values are not lowered
compound Adapt instructions remain material residuals
copied or granted Adapt requires trusted typed ability fragments
triggers referring to a permanent adapting are not represented
